title: Dungeon Reactor Post-Process Console
description: A dungeon environment houses an iridescent lamp and an ion drive reactor. The user operates a post-processing console to tune bloom, chromatic aberration, color grading, vignette, and film grain across both objects, with energy conservation ensuring total effect intensity stays constant, plus full undo/redo support.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with EffectComposer from three/addons. Load dungeon_warkarma.glb as the environment centered at origin scaled to fit a 10-unit bounding box. Place IridescenceLamp.glb on a pedestal at (-2, 0.5, 0) and PrimaryIonDrive.glb hovering at (2, 1.5, 0) with a slow rotation animation. Use a PerspectiveCamera at (0, 3, 8) with OrbitControls. Add one warm PointLight near the lamp and one cool-blue PointLight near the ion drive, plus dim ambient light. Set up an EffectComposer with five post-processing passes: UnrealBloomPass, ShaderPass for chromatic aberration (custom RGB offset shader), ShaderPass for color grading (lift-gamma-gain), ShaderPass for vignette (darkness and offset uniforms), and FilmPass for grain. Create an HTML overlay panel with five labeled sliders (0-100) for each effect. Implement an energy conservation law: the sum of all five slider values must always equal 250. When the user adjusts one slider, the remaining four redistribute proportionally to maintain the total. Each slider change updates the corresponding pass uniforms in real time. Add a coupling toggle button: when enabled, the lamp PointLight intensity scales with bloom value and the ion drive rotation speed scales with chromatic aberration value. Implement an undo/redo stack (minimum 20 states) storing all five slider values per state, activated by on-screen Undo and Redo buttons. Add a Reset button restoring all sliders to 50. Add a checkbox to toggle each pass on/off independently (bypassing conservation when toggled off, redistributing among active passes). Display the current total intensity and per-pass percentage as text. The interaction sequence involves adjusting sliders, toggling coupling, toggling individual passes, using undo/redo, and resetting, totaling 10-14 meaningful steps.
